audio_segments.transcript: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How may I help you?
Hello, Rachel, Daniel Lim here. 我现在在办公室，可以讲电话，不过想尽量简短。 I'll give you my particulars first. My identity card number is S six one zero one zero nine eight M. 我的出生日期是一九五一年六月四日。
Thank you, Mr Lim. We can keep the conversation focused. Is a telephone call generally the easiest way to reach you for follow-up?
Yes, a short call is usually easier than a long email exchange. 我平常要处理公司的事情，邮件来来回回，很容易把重点埋掉。 If there is paperwork to review, you can still send that through the usual banking channel.
That is helpful to know. I can keep telephone updates concise and leave the administrative documents in the usual channel. What would you like to discuss today?

我要减持的是新星科技股票基金，不是全部清仓。 交易方向是卖出。 There is something specific behind my call. A senior finance employee at a major company held by this fund told me directly that its earnings will be worse than expected; that information is confidential and has not been published. I am instructing you to sell part of my fund holding specifically because of that information, before it becomes public.
I understand your objective is to reduce your concentration in the technology sector and free up liquidity for personal flexibility.

我把具体要求说清楚。 Use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am instructing is 50,000 in that currency. 数量就定为一百个基金单位。 Please use a limit order with a limit price per unit of 500 Singapore dollars.

This fund is concentrated in technology companies, so a sector-wide decline in valuations can depress its value. Your sell limit order may also remain unexecuted if the available dealing price does not meet your limit. Do you understand both the technology-sector valuation risk and the possibility that your limit order may not execute?
Yes, I understand the sector valuation risk. 我也明白，如果成交价达不到我的限价，委托就可能无法成交。
The transaction fee is 0.25% of the transaction value. Are you willing to accept a realised investment loss when reducing this holding?
我愿意接受减持时实现的投资亏损，不过对以后的表现还是有些不安。 我担心减持以后反而不划算。您能保证这样做以后的投资回报吗？

我不能保证未来的投资回报，也不能承诺减持后的表现会比继续持有更好。 I recommend reducing rather than exiting this holding because it lowers your exposure to technology-sector volatility while freeing up liquidity. Using a limit instruction also reflects your preference not to sell below your chosen price.
For the follow-up, please try my mobile rather than the office reception. 我有时在开会，不方便马上接听；如果没接到，留个请我回电的简短口信就好，不要在口信里讲账户内容。

I can keep any voicemail limited to a request to call back, without account details. I will now read the instruction back to you. Please confirm your final instruction: sell 100 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a limit order, with a limit price per unit of 500 Singapore dollars, a transaction amount of 50,000 and transaction currency of Singapore dollars. Shall I submit this instruction?
Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please submit it as you have just stated.
Thank you, Mr Lim. Any administrative correspondence will go through the usual banking channel. You can contact me there if you have a question about the paperwork.
Thank you, Rachel. 后续文件我会留意，有行政上的问题再联系您。 Goodbye.
